text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—And here comes the final stretch! Pulling 
away from the pack all at once! Will this 
mark a glorious comeback from long-term 
recovery?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
—Wait, something's wrong? Is there 
trouble...! This is...! Looks like an 
injured leg...

I stood completely stunned... It happened 
while watching the comeback race of that 
girl who had recuperated at the Yukoma hot 
springs.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: ...Welcome, please come in.

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Yes... I'll be counting on you again...

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haha... They said nothing was broken, 
but... I'm so sorry... for ending up like 
this. Even after you accompanied me 
through all that rehab.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Please feel free to call on me whenever 
you're in trouble. I will rush over right 
away.

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, I'm okay... I think I'm just 
going to sleep the whole time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Then maybe we should hold off on rehab for 
a little while? I'll join you next time, 
so—

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text: No... I'd feel bad doing that...

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I am truly sorry. Even after all your 
help... This season is already...

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I wanted to do my best *now*... For it to 
end like this...!

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text: ...... You have my deepest sympathies.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
What should be done? Even if an early 
recovery is achieved at this rate... 
Calculation... impossible.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
“—It can't be helped. You need time to 
feel down, too.”

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Once you get injured a second time, it's 
not like the first. It's never just a 
matter of 'once my body heals.' Fighting a 
pointless battle chips away at your 
spirit.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
For now, we must simply accept it... 
shouldn't we? Let us focus on offering our 
hospitality, just as we always do.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, what the customer said was 
the truth... All the more so if they had 
pinned their hopes on this autumn.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It's the once-in-a-lifetime Classics, 
after all.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Still... even so. It's not over yet...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Teio-san...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
âFouuund you! Aw, and here you said you 
were asleep~!

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
No, I just went out to buy a drink... what 
is it...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
...Hey, wanna hang out for a bit? I'm 
totally free! Come hang out with me♪

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh, play...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Come on, it's fine! Let's go all out and 
have some fun! If you don't have any 
plans, why not?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! My win again!

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, that was impossible~. Give me a 
handicap next time.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Sounds good~! Hehehe! Lord Teio is still 
gonna win anyway♪

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
So deeeliiiicious! You can just keep 
eating hot spring carrots forever, can't 
you~?

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... It's been forever since I had 
sweets... I was cutting back on carbs...

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Aargh... What was I even holding back 
for...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
(Yeah, right... It just makes you sick of 
it all.)

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Haaah―! That feels so good~♪

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Yeah...... Um, hey... What would you do, 
Teio? At a time like this...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Me? What if... I ended up like you...?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Let me see...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If things don't go according to my ideals, 
I'll probably be super... super bummed 
out.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
But... because I'm like that, sometimes I 
can give someone courage... So—

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I believe in miracles! After all, I'm 
"absolute"!

text_block_list.name: Injured Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
......I see. You're really strong, aren't 
you? I'm gonna head out first...

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... As I thought, we must start with 
the mental side first. It's all about 
mindset, you see.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Does that mean... like a "habitual thought 
pattern"? I remember learning about that 
at the academy.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, her current dejection could, in a 
sense, be considered merely in her head.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The intense preconception that "it's 
already over"...

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Embarrassingly enough, I've 
experienced it myself, so I understand 
completely.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
Is it... because of this sense of 
helplessness? I end up deciding my own 
limits myself. Even though, thinking 
calmly, there's no basis for it 
whatsoever.

text_block_list.name: Takeshi Hoshina
text_block_list.text:
I'll reset those habits bit by bit. And 
then, we rebuild your body too.

text_block_list.name: Yunohana Bloom
text_block_list.text:
I think Lady Teio inviting you out to play 
really helped. Having time to just clear 
your mind is important, too. âª

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hmm...! You're right... Even if I can't do 
it all at once...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I'll meddle as many times as it takes! I 
just can't leave a girl like that alone!
